Drag a container of water here to fill the tank. Tainted water works too - concrete does not care. The mixer also draws from containers you are carrying and from anything holding water within two tiles, so a rain collector beside it feeds it directly.

Multiplies the final accident chance after skill scaling. Set to 0 to disable risk without disabling the injury system.
Higher values make machine jobs take longer; lower values make them faster.
Controls whether fluid-powered machines require and consume fuel for operations.
Gas-powered machines expose their operator to dangerous fumes when operated inside an enclosed room. Repeated exposure can become fatal.
Allows configured machine operations to injure the operator. Disable this to remove accident rolls entirely.
Controls wear on installed parts such as circular blades. Required parts must still be installed.
When disabled, operations use their fixed base yield, time and XP and do not cause skill-scaled accidents.
Multiplies fluid fuel consumed per operation. Set to 0 for no fuel usage or requirement.
Multiplies toxic exposure from operating combustion-powered machines indoors. Set to 0 to remove exposure while retaining the warning.
Multiplies blade and other installed-part wear. Set to 0 for no wear.
Adjusts the effective skill used for yield, speed, XP and accident calculations. The UI still displays the character's real skill level.
Multiplies XP awarded by machine operations. Set to 0 to disable machine XP.
Multiplies item output after skill scaling. Results are rounded to the nearest whole item, with at least one output when the operation normally produces something.
Electric. Services any loaded item marked sharpenable, including compatible modded axes, blades and edged tools.

Electric, with a 100L plumbed water tank. Mixes bags of concrete powder into a drum that holds eight buckets worth, then pours them into buckets as you bring them. Clean or tainted water both work, and it draws from containers you carry and from anything holding water within two tiles.
Electric. Compacts metal scrap and forms circular sawblade blanks.
Replaceable continuous blade for the metal bandsaw.
Drill-press tooling. Wears as metal is drilled; a bench grinder can resharpen it until too little of the bit is left.
Replaceable abrasive wheel for the bench grinder.
Seals and fittings for servicing the hydraulic press.
Cutters for the metalwork lathe. A bench grinder can regrind them, and can grind new ones from bar stock.
General machine lubricant. Install it in a machine's oil slot; condition shows the amount left.
Electric. Cuts tires, sawblades, iron stock and sheet metal.
Electric. Turns steel bars into rods and precision metal slugs.
Stores up to 20 propane tanks. Built empty; deposits tanks and refills tanks or blowtorches.
Electric. Drills metal stock and makes specialist blacksmithing tools.
Cuts logs and planks. Requires a circular sawblade.
Cuts logs and planks. Gasoline powered with an 8L tank; needs a circular sawblade. Running it indoors is dangerous.
